name: CreatorPilot
author: Tech Support

sections.description:
🚀 CreatorPilot > Set your SEO writing skills on autopilot with CreatorPilot!

🎯 Unlock Deep Insights into Your Ideal Customer

Stop guessing and start growing! Discover what truly matters to your audience with our powerful analytics suite.

✨ Key Features

  • ICP Analysis: Deep dive into your Ideal Customer Profile
  • JTBD Framework: Understand customer motivations and needs
  • Website Analysis: Get data-driven insights about your audience
  • Content Strategy: Generate SEO-optimized article ideas

🎁 Free Version Includes

  • Analysis for 20 keywords
  • 20 SEO-optimized article suggestions
  • Basic ICP insights
  • Core JTBD framework access

🔒 Security & Privacy

Our commitment to your data security:

  • 🔐 Secure API connection to api.creatorpilot.ai
  • 🌍 EU-based data storage
  • 📧 Email confirmation required
  • 🔑 Anonymous ID system for data sync
  • 💳 Secure payments via Stripe

💎 Premium Features

Upgrade your experience with our premium services:
– Enhanced analysis capabilities
– Advanced reporting features
– Secure payment processing through Stripe
– Optional card storage for convenience

📜 Legal & Trust

Your trust is our priority. Review our policies:

  • Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy

Plugin Details:
– Requires WordPress: 6.0+
– Tested up to: 6.8
– Stable tag: 0.1.1
– License: GPLv2
